4. **`src/transformers/modeling_tf_auto.py`** — Add `DPRConfig` → TF DPR model mapping to `TF_MODEL_MAPPING` (like PyTorch does with `(DPRConfig, DPRQuestionEncoder)` at line 261 of `modeling_auto.py`). Also import the TF DPR classes at the top of the file.

5. **`src/transformers/convert_pytorch_checkpoint_to_tf2.py`** — Add DPR entries to `MODEL_CLASSES` dict (around lines 190-260) with appropriate config/TF model/PT model/archive map tuples, and import the relevant classes.

6. **`docs/source/model_doc/dpr.rst`** — Add documentation sections for the TF DPR models.
